question: In a certain code, "GAME" is written as "ICOG". How will "PLAY" be written in the same code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed in this pattern is a consistent shift of each letter by two positions forward in the alphabet.

**For 'GAME' related to 'ICOG':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cdd5abedf319a5e48717420c246528eb08c0b257db786b51a679a1378440e2d.png] 

**Applying the same logic to 'PLAY':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9a4368cb380f26fe76bc5568788286c790095d24128bec24af0589110e8ad46.png] 

Thus, 'PLAY' is coded as 'RNCA'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
